summary: The change allows documented DELETE bodies while preserving the required-body and schema checks. The focused test verifies a body-bearing DELETE succeeds and that missing, invalid, and unsupported bodies are rejected before the network.

evidence: scripts/api_cli_operations.ts no longer rejects DELETE bodies and still performs the required-body check and schema validation before planning a request.
tests/api-cli.test.ts exercises delete_api_admin_users_userId with its required reason body and asserts schema and missing-body failures happen before any network call.
